bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 68 (Monday, April 24, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. BARR:
H.R. 2798.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article 1, Section 8, Clause 3: to regulate commerce with
foreign nations, and among the several states, and with the
Indian tribes; and
Article 1, Section 8, Clause 18: to make all Laws which
shall be necessary and proper for carrying into Execution
foregoing
The single subject of this legislation is:
To make reforms to the Consumer Financial Protection Board
[Page H1915]
